mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_type, user_id, user_name, action, module, target, method, uri, ip, detail, status, cost_ms, create_time) VALUES (#{userType}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{action}, #{module}, #{target}, #{method}, #{uri}, #{ip}, #{detail}, #{status}, #{costMs}, #{createTime})

where.if: AND (user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR uri LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT id, user_type, user_id, user_name, action, module, target, method, uri, ip, detail, status, cost_ms, create_time FROM audit_log
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT action AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_log GROUP BY action ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM audit_log WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
